answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents deposit stake on a terrace of trust tiers and undergo game-theoretic multi-agent auditing. Topological cut verifications trace transaction flows like a river, identifying sparse network bottlenecks to detect fake clusters and trigger stake slashing. At each audit dawn, coordinated Sybil spoofing imposes a superlinear attacker cost scaling with the cut capacity, rendering identity replication economically unviable.
